architecture.mechanism: Increasing acceleration during passage through resonance to reduce maximum radial displacement amplitude.
architecture.intervention: Modify the engine control unit (ECU) mapping for the 2020 Nissan Sentra to increase the rate of torque delivery (acceleration) when traversing the specific RPM range corresponding to the drivetrain's critical speed, thereby minimizing the time spent in resonance and reducing vibration amplitude.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced vibration magnitude during highway acceleration as the drivetrain passes through its critical speed, restoring smooth operation without compromising safety.
architecture.falsification_test: Instrument the vehicle drivetrain with accelerometers and perform a controlled acceleration test from 65 MPH to 75 MPH; if the peak vibration amplitude does not decrease compared to the baseline stock ECU map, the mechanism is falsified.
